prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions were generally too optimistic overall, but underestimated gains on several winning home wait_info tests.
Adding new screens at adoption (2 tests) or finish (2 tests) consistently hurt performance and triggered early stops.
Redesigning the adoption stage (3 wins) and choose_path stage (2 wins) proved helpful.
Updating home wait_info frequently generated wins (5 wins), although many tests showed no clear effect.
Finish copy changes (4 tests), finish layout changes (2 tests), sign-in hints (2 tests), and home redesigns (2 tests) consistently showed no clear effect.
Evidence remains thin or mixed for change types with only one test or conflicting outcomes.

Changes:
0: [choose_path, new_screen] Companion Path Teaser Stage Screen: Insert a short introductory teaser screen right before path selection to prime users on pet adoption vs custom pet creation options. (why: Users stall on path selection (mean 514s). Setting context before presenting choices reduces cognitive load and speeds up decision-making.)
1: [home, wait_info] Interactive Render Stage Activity Feed: Display dynamic render milestone progress updates and waiting tip carousels during companion generation. (why: The waiting step has a 201s median / 2336s mean time. Lessons show updating home wait_info frequently yields wins.)
2: [home, wait_info] Desktop Arrival Interactive Tip Stream: Add an animated hatching mascot visualization with notify-when-ready options on the generation waiting screen. (why: Home wait stage drops off 5.7% of users while taking up to 2336s on average. Interactive wait elements keep users engaged.)
3: [choose_path, new_flow] Guided Path Introduction Sub-Flow: Add an exploratory path guidance screen prior to selection, streamlining decision making with structured path cards. (why: High mean duration (514s) at choose_path suggests confusion. Giving structured previews in a new flow helps users select faster.)
4: [sign_in, copy] Account Pet Preservation Sign-In Focus: Update sign-in copy to explicitly clarify that signing in protects and syncs pet state across application restarts. (why: Support received 8 emails about pets missing or reset after signing in again, and sign-in has a 75.1% conversion rate.)
5: [home, wait_info] Companion Desktop Launch Progress Status: Display step-by-step milestone progress text explaining render status while users wait for pet spawn. (why: Users wait a median of 201s during home generation. Dynamic wait info reduces perceived wait time and abandoned runs.)
6: [adoption, layout] Custom Photo Upload Guidance Layout: Switch photo upload layout to card format with visual preview highlights and clarity instructions. (why: Support reported 3 bugs where custom pet photo generation failed or looked wrong during adoption.)
7: [finish, notification] Desktop Controls & Visibility Launch Callout: Add an explicit system tray shortcut badge and interaction hint callout on the final home intro screen. (why: Finish stage converts at 70.9% and support received multiple emails from users confused about how to control, hide, or talk to their pet after onboarding.)

scores.note: Adding extra screens to onboarding consistently hurts conversion (-0.4% historically for choose_path new_screen).
Home wait_info changes have a solid track record (5 wins, +1.3% historical average) addressing long wait times.
Interactive wait screen updates fit a proven pattern of improving engagement during long home wait times.
Inserting new flows before selection adds friction; historical choose_path new_flow tests resulted in -2.4% drop.
Strong alignment between high sign_in dropoff (24.9%) and 8 support tickets; easy copy fix with good upside.
Step-by-step render status directly targets the 201s median wait with a high-confidence wait_info pattern.
3 support tickets highlight issues with photo upload; layout change previously showed +2.4% lift.
Finish step drops 29.1% and has user emails, but finish tweaks historically show no clear effect or negative impact.
